title: Queen María of Castile to Alfonso V, Valencia, 5 Aug 1435, ACA Cancillería reg. 3225 f. 59r (DECODE R10171)

steps.what: Full image of f. 59r fetched from DECODE R10171 without login.
Clear text of the three register items read; the three cipher runs transcribed sign by sign (cipher.txt, 42 signs).
Context: the truce of Majano expired 16 July 1435 and was extended; run 2 before 'es continuada daci a Tots Sants' = 'la treua [ab Castella]' as the leading crib.
Prior literature checked for a reading of the letter: nothing in print.
DECODE ACA keys: R10182 (1413) a jargon code; R10183, the 1437 Montcada-Amat alphabet, a different alphabet from the letter's.
Reg. 3226 (264 images) swept in full for sibling cipher: none.
Reg. 3224 (286 images) swept in full: no cipher.
Reg. 2693 (392 images) swept: no cipher signs or key, but 'Fuit expedita in cifra' entries including Alfonso to the queen, Gaeta 27 July 1435, 'In ciffra': a king-queen cipher in use that week.
Reg. 3113 (472 images) swept: no cipher. Cartas Reales Alfonso IV on PARES: no ciphered 1435 king-queen originals.

Printed 1429 Castile-war key (Cortes & Pons 1986) obtained and compared: alphabet does not carry over; nomenclator signs seem to match (regne d'Arago, Catalunya, rei de Castella, Navarra) as a hypothesis only.

Annealing, one sign = one letter, Catalan quadgram model, with and without the 1429 look-alike values and cribs (la treua, treua, tregua, castella, M z = es): every crib heavily penalised, output gibberish.

Matched control (control.py, control_out.txt): 60+60 synthetic Catalan texts in f. 59r's exact layout (runs of 11/14/17 signs, 39 letters + 3 word signs, 18+3 = 21 distinct), monoalphabetic and 1429-style homophonic keys, solve.anneal() unchanged (20 seeds x 200k). Recovered (>= 80% letters) 0/60 and 0/60; median accuracy 0.08 / 0.13; solver optimum above the true key in 120/120. A true 5-letter crib is penalised by median 42-46 (>= 35 in 79/120), as much as the target's cribs, so the crib penalties are not evidence against a monoalphabetic cipher.

outcome.fraction_read_source: cipher.txt: 42 signs, none given a value (the nomenclator matches are a hypothesis)

gaps.detail: Matched control: the annealer recovers 0/120 synthetic texts of this exact layout and sign inventory, monoalphabetic or homophonic.
Needs reg. 3225's other 1435 folios (ACA, not digitised), the second key of B.A.H.M. ms. 677 ff. 160-161, or a queen-side key at the ARV.

outcome.notes: Attempted, closed from the evidence. Matched control run 2026-09-22: 0/120 recovered at this length, so the solver negative says nothing about the cipher (too short); the earlier crib-penalty argument against a monoalphabetic cipher is withdrawn.

prior.where: Prior literature checked, nothing in print (NOTES); DECODE status non-decrypted.

human: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the oldest-cipher candidate list (oldest/CANDIDATES.md A1). The image is public on DECODE. No target-specific intervention recorded in NOTES or git.
